name: VPN Pineapple
author: Taylor Burke
description: A pineapple on the bar that shows your VPN status: upright while the tunnel is up, upside down and muted while it is down. Click it to connect or disconnect.

barWidget.description: VPN status pineapple with a connect/disconnect drawer

schema.label: VPN
schema.description: Fills in the interface and the Connect/Disconnect commands. Custom uses only the fields below.

schema.label: Name
schema.description: Shown in the tooltip and drawer. Blank uses the preset's name.

schema.label: Network interface
schema.description: The pineapple is upright while this interface exists (see `ip link`). Blank uses the preset's: Eddie, wg0 or wg0-mullvad.

schema.label: Connect command
schema.description: Overrides the preset's Connect action. Runs with bash.

schema.label: Disconnect command
schema.description: Overrides the preset's Disconnect action. Runs with bash.

schema.label: Run custom commands in a terminal
schema.description: Needed for commands that ask for a sudo password. Applies only to the two commands above.
